name: Wu Sushi & Bento Bar
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Wu Sushi & Bento Bar in Kufstein!**

Discover a taste of Japan in the heart of Tirol. At **Wu Sushi & Bento Bar**, we bring you authentic flavors with a fresh twist. Indulge in our carefully crafted sushi rolls, from classic nigiri to creative maki, all made with the finest ingredients.

Our bento boxes are a delightful mix of traditional Japanese dishes, perfectly balanced for a satisfying meal. Whether you're craving spicy tuna, delicate salmon avocado, or a hearty bowl of ramen, we’ve got something for every palate.

Pair your meal with our selection of premium Japanese beers, sake, or a refreshing matcha latte. The cozy atmosphere makes it the perfect spot to unwind after exploring the beauty of **Kufstein** or the surrounding **Tirol** landscapes.

Come visit us and let your taste buds travel to Japan—right here in the Alps!
